title: Harry and Meghan are back to cash in on Britain’s $680 million royal lie
text:
Don’t look now, but Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are returning to the United Kingdom and to the headlines. My reaction? As Valley Girls used to say, gag me with a fork.

I love London and St. Andrews, Winston Churchill and Margaret Thatcher, Chaucer and Shakespeare, the Beatles and the Stones. British food? Not so much. But everything else? I’m a confirmed Anglophile.
